description: Schema changes: Add Company model with name, normalizedName, slug, notes (intelligence), dreamCompany flag. Add dreamCompany and dreamJob boolean fields to Job model. Add companyId foreign key to Job model linking to Company. Add migration-safe schema that allows existing jobs to have null companyId initially.
steps: Update prisma/schema.prisma to add Company model with fields: id (cuid), name (String), normalizedName (String), slug (String @unique), notes (String? - intelligence field), dreamCompany (Boolean @default(false)), createdAt, updatedAt. Add indexes on normalizedName and slug.
Add to Job model: dreamCompany (Boolean @default(false)), dreamJob (Boolean @default(false)), companyId (String? - nullable for existing jobs), company relation to Company model (optional).
Add relation field to Company model: jobs Job[] (one-to-many).
Run 'npx prisma generate' to regenerate the Prisma client in src/generated/prisma/.
Run 'npm run build' to verify everything compiles cleanly with the new schema.
acceptance_criteria: prisma/schema.prisma contains Company model with all specified fields
Job model has dreamCompany, dreamJob booleans and optional companyId relation
npx prisma generate succeeds without errors
npm run build passes with no type errors
verification: Run 'npx prisma generate' and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
